data.heading: Schema-Driven Content for Astro
data.body: Astro pages stay explicit while content shapes stay validated.

data.heading: Why schema validation matters
data.body:
External content is untrusted input. A Git file can be malformed, a CMS field can be empty, and a URL can point nowhere. NexusContent validates declared fields at retrieval time, so a missing required heading fails during the build instead of rendering a broken page.

Undeclared fields pass through, which lets a provider stay loose while the parts the site depends on stay strict.
